[name="戴菲恩"]哈啊……哈啊……
[charslot(slot="m",name="avgnew_112_siege_1#5$2",focus="m")]
[name="推进之王"]你没事吧？！
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_866_1#7$1",focus="m")]
[name="戴菲恩"]不，只是心理上的……我没事。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avgnew_112_siege_1#10$2",focus="m")]
[name="推进之王"]下面的敌人攻势已经被你们的部队限制，我们上来支援。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avgnew_112_siege_1#10$2",focus="m")]
[name="推进之王"]坏消息，我们在下面发现了变形者的踪迹。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_866_1#7$1",focus="m")]
[name="戴菲恩"]我们已经知道了，血魔大君正在和变形者交替进攻。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_866_1#8$1",focus="m")]
[name="戴菲恩"]不，等等……
[dialog]
[Blocker(a=0.6, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="刚才那一击，不是变形者的佯攻，那是真真切切，来自于血魔的巫术。", x=300,y=270,  alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n如果那位王庭之主打算杀了我，我一定已经成了一具尸体。",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n我抵挡住了，这绝不是因为我的强大。",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n这只能说明，他本身就另有所图。",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1")]
[charslot]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="我再次看向不远处。剑卫们的剑光仍在。我隐约看见他们的身影凝成一团——", x=300,y=270,  alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1")]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="不对。", x=300,y=270,  alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n他们……正在一个接一个地……倒下。",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n他们在后退？",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1")]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="不对！", x=300,y=270,  alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n妈妈呢？",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1")]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[musicvolume(volume=0.6, fadetime=1)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avgnew_112_siege_1#8$2",focus="m")]
[name="推进之王"]戴菲恩，你要去哪儿？！
[dialog]
[dialog]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avgnew_112_siege_1#10$2",focus="m")]
[Blocker(a=0.7, r=0.95, g=0.95, b=0.95, fadetime=0.02, block=true)]
[PlaySound(key="$e_skill_skulsrsword",volume=1)]
[PlaySound(key="$swordtsing1",volume=0.6)]
[Effect(name="$e_spark_01_large",layer=2)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.25, block=true)]
[CameraShake(duration=2, xstrength=20, ystrength=20, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[delay(time=1)]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_425_1#1$1",focus="m",duration=1)]
[delay(time=2)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avgnew_112_siege_1#10$2",focus="m")]
[name="推进之王"]嘁，真难缠！
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_425_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="赦罪师直属卫兵"]……
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_425_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="赦罪师直属卫兵"]（萨卡兹语）血的味道变了。赦罪师阁下已经得手，大君也取得了胜利。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_425_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="赦罪师直属卫兵"]（萨卡兹语）撤退。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_425_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="赦罪师直属卫兵"]（萨卡兹语）无法自如行动的人，听我号令，将匕首插入胸膛。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avgnew_112_siege_1#10$2",focus="m")]
[name="推进之王"]你们——
[dialog]
[Charslot]
[Blocker(a=0.7, r=0.95, g=0.95, b=0.95, fadetime=0.02, block=true)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_sp_ballista")]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.25, block=true)]
[CameraShake(duration=0.6, xstrength=5, ystrength=8, vibrato=30, randomness=90, block=true)]
[delay(time=1)]
[dialog]
[Blocker(a=1, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=2, block=true)]
[PlaySound(key="$rungeneral", volume=1)]
[Blocker(a=1, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=2, block=true)]
[delay(time=1)]
[dialog]
[charslot]
[Blocker(a=0.6, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="不可能。", x=300,y=270,  alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n就算被假血魔消耗了体力，剑卫们和妈妈绝不可能这么轻易被打倒。",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n我听过那些传说，毁灭高塔的光之利刃，刺穿岩壁的温德米尔，维多利亚最锋锐的两把剑刃之一。",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n我从小听到大。",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1")]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="为什么？怎么会？", x=300,y=270,  alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1")]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="我一头扎进了那片血雾，只能听见自己的心跳在加速。", x=300,y=270,  alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n终于，我看见了人影。",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1")]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[dialog]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_410_1#1$1",focus="m",duration=1)]
[delay(time=1)]

[CameraShake(duration=2, xstrength=10, ystrength=8, vibrato=20, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_explosion", volume=1)]
[Blocker(a=1, r=1, g=1, b=1, fadetime=0.2, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0.6, r=1, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.2, block=true)]

[name="温德米尔公爵"]……呃。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_426_1#6$1",focus="m")]
[name="变形者集群"]……你的双臂已经失去知觉，你的护卫们也溃不成军。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_426_1#6$1",focus="m")]
[name="变形者集群"]你现在，正怀抱着什么形状的情感？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_426_1#6$1",focus="m")]
[name="变形者集群"]……
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_868_1#3$1",focus="m")]
[name="温德米尔公爵"]……哈啊……哈啊……
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_868_1#6$1",focus="m")]
[name="温德米尔公爵"]萨卡兹……
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_426_1#2$1",focus="m")]
[name="变形者集群"]他抓住了你。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_426_1#2$1",focus="m")]
[name="变形者集群"]一瞬间的破绽，一瞬间的自乱阵脚……为什么？我们不理解。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_426_1#2$1",focus="m")]
[name="变形者集群"]我们……感到惋惜。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_868_1#6$1",focus="m")]
[name="温德米尔公爵"]……
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_410_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="血魔大君"]……
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_410_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="血魔大君"]她已经没救了。就让这位强大的战士独自品味生命的凋零吧。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_426_1#6$1",focus="m")]
[name="变形者集群"]你要离开？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_410_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="血魔大君"]余下的不过是卑小的死亡。罢了，我实在是提不起兴趣了。
[dialog]
[Blocker(a=0.6, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="这个恶鬼只是轻轻扫了我一眼，我全身的血液就已经凝固冻结。", x=300,y=270,  alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n但他没有动手。",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1")]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_410_1#2$1",focus="m")]
[name="血魔大君"]这些血，千篇一律。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_426_1#10$1",focus="m")]
[name="变形者集群"]你在追求什么？我们……还不确定。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_410_1#2$1",focus="m")]
[name="血魔大君"]……
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_410_1#2$1",focus="m")]
[name="血魔大君"]屈辱的时代就要结束了。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_426_1#10$1",focus="m")]
[name="变形者集群"]你受伤了？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_410_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="血魔大君"]……无关紧要。
[dialog]
[Charslot(duration=1)]
[delay(time=1)]
[dialog]
[charslot]
[Blocker(a=0.6, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="他没入鲜血之中，就这么销声匿迹。", x=300,y=270,  alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1")]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]

[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_426_1#8$1",focus="m")]
[name="变形者集群"]……嗯，你在这里。
[dialog]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_humanchange")]

[name="变形者集群"]你是那个识破了我们的人。
[name="变形者集群"]他说我们退步了……上一个我们，有多像？
[name="变形者集群"]这样，足够吗？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_866_1#3$1",focus="m")]
[name="戴菲恩"]你——别顶着她的脸——
[dialog]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_868_1#8$1",focus="m")]
[Blocker(a=0.6, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="他用妈妈的脸对我笑了。", x=300,y=270,  alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1")]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[dialog]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_868_1#8$1",focus="m")]
[name="变形者集群"]……我们需要尝试。

[PlaySound(key="$knifegore", volume=1)]
